name: centricmem-skill
description: Hosted CentricMem librarian: organise and retrieve Markdown memory via host MCP.

interface.longDescription: Organise and retrieve Markdown memory on the hosted CentricMem librarian. After install, this agent (and each client you install into) tries https://centricmem.com/login?signup=1 and a /connect?device= URL. Plugin mcp.json or mcp add with no Bearer is not a completed connect. If minting that URL fails, run centricmem doctor connect and they email zeyu@poppyg.com with that output; then MCP OAuth only if this agent will receive the browser login. Never paste keys in chat. Never download a settings file that contains a key.
defaultPrompt: Search my CentricMem shelves for that decision.
Connect this agent to the CentricMem librarian. If cm_* are missing, send signup and a /connect?device= URL this turn.
